subject.title: [Bug]: z.ai endpoint auto-detection probe sends no User-Agent → z.ai 429s it, detectZaiEndpoint returns null, Coding Plan onboarding fails

question: Which linked Z.AI User-Agent PR should be the canonical landing path, and should live Z.AI Coding Plan proof be required or explicitly waived before merge?
rationale: The code fix is narrow, but current main is still unfixed, live provider proof requires credentials, and multiple open PRs compete for the same issue.

options.title: Choose one tested PR with proof or waiver
options.body: Select the best-scoped linked PR, require redacted live proof or explicitly waive it, then close duplicate candidates after that PR lands.

options.title: Wait for live provider proof
options.body: Keep all candidates paused until a contributor or maintainer can show after-fix Coding Plan endpoint detection against the real service.

options.title: Decline the candidate PRs
options.body: Keep this issue open but close the current duplicate PRs if maintainers want a different implementation or proof plan.

recommendation.title: Choose one tested PR with proof or waiver
recommendation.body: Select the best-scoped linked PR, require redacted live proof or explicitly waive it, then close duplicate candidates after that PR lands.

likelyOwner.reason: The Z.AI endpoint detection feature history points to steipete, and the live issue is currently assigned to him.
